raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 149 duplicated txn_id values in raw_transactions are exact copies, identical in every column including batch_id and ingest_ts, so they are redelivered duplicates rather than conflicting records. silver_transactions copies them through unchanged, and the gold tables inherit the double counts. Adding DISTINCT to silver_transactions removes the exact copies without changing any values, and the gold steps read from silver, so they are corrected on rerun.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
